page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, left and right, with the running head and page number at the top. Heading "מ ת" centred above the left column. No marginal notes. Catchword "Kal;" at the bottom right, gathering signature "Mm" at the bottom left.

main_text.l: מֵת mortuus est, הָמֵּת mor-tuus ne est ? וּ־מֵת & mortuus fuit, וָמֵת & morietur, præt. Kal, 3. s. m. præf. R. מוּת.
מֵת moriens, mortuus, Benoni Kal, vel, No. Part. s. m. Rad. מוּת mori.
מִתְאַב abominor, Part. Pi-el, s. m. à R. תָּאַב desi-deravit, in Piel, תֵּאֵב abominari, vel est pro מְתָעֵב abominatur, Part. Piel, s. m. Rad. תָּעַב, in Piel, תִּעֵב abomina-natus est.
מְתַאֵּים concupiscentes, Part. Hitph. pl. m. à s. m. מִתְאַוֶּה, Rad. אָוָה concupiscit.
כְּמִתְאַנְּנִים sicut plan-gentes, Part. Hitph. pl. m. præf. Rad. אָנַן.
מִתְאֵימוֹת gemelliparæ, Part. Hiph. plur. fæm. Rad. תָּאַם.
מִתְאַנָּה occasionem quæ-rens, Part. Hithp. sing. masc. Rad. אָנָה.
הַמִּתְאָֽר qui describitur, Part. Pual, s. m. R. תָּאַר.
מַתְבֵּן stramen, palea, No. s. m. à No. R. תֶּבֶן.
מִתְבַּסָּסָה conculcata, vel בּוֹס, Part. Hithp. s. f. Rad. בּוֹס.
מִתְבָּרֵךְ benedicens sibi, Part. Hithp. s. m. R. בָּרַךְ.
מִתְנוֹרְדִים incidentes se, Part. Hithp. pl. m. Rad. נָרַד.
מִתְגּוֹרֵר commorans, disse-cans, Part. Hithp. s. m. R. גּוּר, vel, גָּרַר.
מִתְגּוֹלֵל volutans se, Part. Hithp. s. m. R. גָּלַל.
מִתְגָּרֶה à conflictu, No. s. f. תְּגָרָה conflictus, constr. præf. Rad. גָּרָה miscere.

page.notes: Vowel points and dagesh marks in the Hebrew are small and partly doubtful; forms such as הָמֵּת, מְתַאֵּים, מִתְאָֽר and מֻתָּה are read from the scan and may need checking. The left-column entry "מִתְאֵימוֹת" continues into the right column ("Rad. תָּאַם."), so it is written as one paragraph. The line "mor-tuus" keeps its printed hyphen across the line break. The catchword "Kal;" is taken from the foot of the right column.
